assumptions.choice: The 10-day interval uses the Open from 9 bars before the current bar and the current Close.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal 10-bar interval ending on the current day using the specified period open-day and close-day prices.

assumptions.choice: The absolute percentage price change must be strictly greater than 20%.
assumptions.reason: The specification says the move may be up or down and must be more than X%.

assumptions.choice: Average daily dollar volume is calculated as 10-day average share volume multiplied by the current Close.
assumptions.reason: The supplied feed has share Volume but no dollar-volume field.

assumptions.choice: Buy size uses all available cash after reserving the stated 0.001 commission.
assumptions.reason: This implements 100% available-capital sizing without creating a margin rejection from commission.

assumptions.choice: The position is closed after five subsequent daily bars from the completed entry order unless the stop-loss or take-profit exits first.
assumptions.reason: The feed is daily and the specification defines Z in days.
There is one AAPL feed, so there is at most one same-bar signal to process.

assumptions.choice: No market-capitalization filter, S&P 500 benchmark, or performance-metric evaluation is implemented.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment provides only AAPL OHLCV data and a strategy class has no supplied market-cap or benchmark data.

assumptions.choice: The strategy does not restrict orders to the final three years of the supplied feed.
assumptions.reason: The required class receives the fixed feed but no declared testing-window boundary; benchmark/metric testing is outside the strategy's available inputs.
